headline: Hatzidakis: Interventions on three axes by Mitsotakis at the Thessaloniki International Fair (TIF)
summary: Greek minister Hatzidakis said Prime Minister Mitsotakis will announce initiatives on three axes at the Thessaloniki International Fair. These address the consequences of high prices and a growth dividend.
why: Government price-relief and growth measures can affect Greek inflation, fiscal spending and domestic consumer demand.
